42 weeks and 7 days = 42*7 + 7 = 294 + 7 = 301 days.  
Subtract 301 days from 1793-08-21.  
1793 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days before Aug 21 in 1793: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31 = 212 days. So Aug 21 is day 212+21 = 233rd day of year.  
233 - 301 = -68 days. Go back to previous year.  
1792 is a leap year (divisible by 4, 1700s not century leap rule until 1700? Actually 1700 was not leap, 1792 is leap).  
Days in 1792: 366.  
366 - 68 = 298th day of 1792.  
298 - 31 (Jan) - 29 (Feb) - 31 (Mar) - 30 (Apr) - 31 (May) - 30 (Jun) - 31 (Jul) - 31 (Aug) = 298-244=54 into September? Wait, sum Jan-Aug in leap year: 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244. 298-244=54. So Oct 23? That’s wrong, 244 is through August, September has 30 days, so 298-244=54 means 54 days after Aug 31: Sep 1–30 is 30 days, 54-30=24 into October. So Oct 24, 1792.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1792-10-24
